title: A Framework for Automated Generation of Questions Across Formal Domains
abstract: In this paper, we present a framework for the automated generation of questions across formal domains such as mathematics, computer science, and logic. Our framework leverages domain-specific knowledge along with natural language processing techniques to produce questions that test a variety of cognitive skills. We discuss the design and implementation of this framework, as well as its application in instructional settings.
summary:
The paper "A Framework for Automated Generation of Questions Across Formal Domains" presents a novel framework that integrates domain-specific knowledge with natural language processing to generate questions in fields such as mathematics and computer science. The primary aim is to enhance instructional methods by generating questions that challenge various cognitive skills. 

A web search indicates that the framework discussed in this paper has not been widely cited or adopted in subsequent research literature or industry applications. No significant references or citations were found that clearly indicate the continued influence or implementation of the framework in other works or technologies.
